item.title: Lines in Control: Why the First Lesson Starts with Lines
item.description: Pencil control, line variety, and the reason Drawing Field Kit Vol. 1 begins with simple marks.

item.title: Seeing Empty Space: Look Before You Draw
item.description: Negative space gives students something concrete to observe when objects feel complicated.

item.title: Building Simple Shapes: When the Drawing Feels Too Big

item.title: Why Blank Pages Freeze Beginning Artists
item.description: A blank page looks simple to an experienced artist. To a beginner, it can feel like being asked to solve every drawing problem at once.
